leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a custom NonEmptyArray type using TypeScript's type system
Apply the NonEmptyArray type to enforce array length constraints in function parameters
Implement type guards to validate NonEmptyArray instances at runtime
Manipulate existing array types by extending them with non-empty constraints
Integrate the NonEmptyArray type with generic functions for type-safe operations
Configure type inference to work correctly with NonEmptyArray in various contexts
Initialize and populate NonEmptyArray instances with proper type safety
